name: Yagiri Seiji
source: Seiji is the younger brother of Namie Yagiri and a student at Raira Academy. He is in love with Celty's head and accepts Mika's love simply because she looks like the head he fell in love with as a child.
translation: Seiji is the younger brother of Namie Yagiri and a student at Raira Academy. He is in love with Celty's head and accepts Mika's love simply because she looks like the head he fell in love with as a child.
